figurative_meaning_bn: কোন জিনিস বিক্রয় বা নষ্ট করা
figurative_meaning_en: To sell or destroy something (often implying disposal of worthless items)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ভাঙা আসবাবপেট্রি বিক্রমপুর পাঠানোই ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: I've sent the old car to Bikrampur.
It's better to send this broken furniture to Bikrampur.
history: Bikrampur (বিক্রমপুর) refers to a historical region in present-day Munshiganj District, Bangladesh, known as an ancient center of learning and administration in Bengal during medieval times, often associated with finality or disposal in idiomatic usage.
note: The idiom draws from the historical prestige of Bikrampur, contrasting with its figurative sense of discarding items.
